Subject: Request: Net60 terms + staggered invoice cadence

Hi Ben,

Hope youre well. Quick ask from our AP team: OrionTech is requesting Net60 payment terms for the pilot-to-production contract (reference OR-2026-1073). Given our internal calendar and approval cycles, Net30 is a challenge for this first year. Also — to make cashflow easier on our side — could we do a staggered invoice cadence: 50% on activation, 25% after 30 days, 25% on 60 days (with Net60 payment from invoice date)?

Were also VAT registered in the EU; please confirm how Redwood will handle VAT invoices for any EU usage. Ive attached the AP request form and can loop Marco (payments) for the procurement redlines.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Romero
Head of Procurement, OrionTech
Attachments: OrionTech_AP_Request_20260910.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Romero <lisa.romero@oriontech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 terms + staggered invoice cadence

Lisa, thank you for the context and the AP form  received it. Short answers up front:
- Net60: we can consider Net60 for a 12-month pilot subject to a credit facility cap and a signed payment schedule.
- Staggered invoices: the 50/25/25 split is fine operationally; well need to reflect that in the SOW/invoice line items.
- VAT: we will issue VAT invoices for EU-registered entities; Ill confirm the exact invoicing flow with finance (reverse-charge vs Redwood VAT depending on jurisdiction).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill route this to Finance and request a credit assessment (well need company bank ref + 1 year of AP aging).
2) Lauren from Finance will draft proposed credit facility terms.
3) If that looks good, Legal will draw the amended payment schedule and well DocuSign.

Looping Lauren/Hannah to pick up the credit assessment and VAT question. Do you have a contact at your bank for references, or shall we proceed with standard credit checks?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Romero <lisa.romero@oriontech.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 terms + staggered invoice cadence

Hi Lisa / Ben,

I ran a quick credit check and drafted proposed parameters. See the attached draft (Draft_Credit_Facility_Terms_20260914.docx). Highlights:
- Credit cap: USD 250,000 for a 90-day review window.
- Payment term: Net60 agreed for invoices under the credit cap.
- Invoice cadence: Accepting the 50/25/25 split as milestone-based invoicing.
- Late fee: 1.5% monthly after 90 days past invoice date unless a remediation plan is in place.
- Security: Redwood will require an ACH mandate and one bank reference; no personal guarantees.

On VAT: for any EU-registered legal entities of OrionTech we will issue VAT invoices. If OrionTech provides a valid VAT registration number and confirms intra-EU B2B reverse-charge eligibility, Redwood will not charge EU VAT; otherwise Redwood will apply UK/EU VAT per jurisdiction. Ive attached Redwoods VAT certificate for your tax team to review.

If those parameters look acceptable, Ben -- please confirm youll send the signed AP form + bank reference and well prepare the DocuSign package.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Draft_Credit_Facility_Terms_20260914.docx; Redwood_VAT_Certificate.pdf
